title: Musa, Part 7: The Signs
fact_notes: Line 1: 7:133; 2-3: 7:130; 4-5: 7:131 (saw an evil omen in Musa and those with him); 6: 7:132; 7-8: 7:133; 9-10: 7:134; 11: 7:135 (removed until a term); 12: 7:136 (drowned in the sea, told next part)
No order, duration or count of the signs is claimed beyond the Qur'an's list; 'one sign after another' follows 'distinct signs' (mufassalat).

lines.text: Flood, locusts, lice, frogs and blood. One sign after another.
lines.spoken: Flood, locusts, lice, frogs and blood. One sign after another.

lines.text: Then Allah seized Pharaoh's people with years of famine and failing fruits.
lines.spoken: Then Allah seized Pharaoh's people with years of famine and failing fruits.

lines.text: It was so that they might be reminded.
lines.spoken: It was so that they might be reminded.

lines.text: But when good came, they said: "This is ours."
lines.spoken: But when good came, they said: "This is ours."

lines.text: And when hardship struck, they blamed Musa and those with him.
lines.spoken: And when hardship struck, they blamed Musa and those with him.

lines.text: They said: "Whatever sign you bring us, we will never believe you."
lines.spoken: They said: "Whatever sign you bring us, we will never believe you."

lines.text: So Allah sent the flood, locusts, lice, frogs and blood, as clear signs.
lines.spoken: So Allah sent the flood, locusts, lice, frogs and blood, as clear signs.

lines.text: But they were arrogant, a criminal people.
lines.spoken: But they were arrogant, a criminal people.

lines.text: When the punishment fell on them, they begged: "Musa, pray to your Lord for us."
lines.spoken: When the punishment fell on them, they begged: "Musa, pray to your Lord for us."

lines.text: "Remove it, and we will believe, and send the Children of Israel with you."
lines.spoken: "Remove it, and we will believe, and send the Children of Israel with you."

lines.text: But when Allah lifted it for a time, at once they broke their word.
lines.spoken: But when Allah lifted it for a time, at once they broke their word.

lines.text: Their promises were empty, and the sea was waiting. Follow for Part 8.
lines.spoken: Their promises were empty, and the sea was waiting. Follow for Part eight.
